entities.summary: Heinrich Simon Ludwig Friedrich Felix Rehm was a German mycologist and lichenologist. He studied at the Universities of Erlangen, Munich and Heidelberg, earning his medical doctorate in 1852. During his career, he was a practicing physician in Dietenhofen, Sugenheim, and Windsheim. In 1875, he became regional medical examiner in Lohr am Main.
